latest.title: The AWS Diagram MCP Server Was Deprecated — Here's the Updated Approach Using Agent Skills
latest.description:
The awslabs.aws-diagram-mcp-server package has been yanked from PyPI. If you're trying to generate AWS architecture diagrams following the official blog post, it won't work anymore. The capability migrated to the Agent Skills system in
  the deploy-on-aws plugin. I documented the updated setup: how to install the plugin, configure MCP servers, and generate professional editable .drawio diagrams with official AWS4 icons using Kiro CLI and natural language prompts.
